hints.title: Preorder Sequence Alignment
hints.text: Compare tree nodes against the voyage sequence using a pointer advancing through voyage in preorder.

hints.title: Child Value Mismatch Flip Trigger
hints.text: If a node has a left child whose value does not match the next voyage value, we must flip its left and right children.

hints.title: Recursive Traversal with Pointer Tracking
hints.text: Maintain index i in voyage. For current node: if node is None return True. If node.val does not equal voyage[i], return False. Advance i. If node.left exists and node.left.val does not equal voyage[i]: record node.val as flipped, traverse right then left. Else traverse left then right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 2^N flip permutations takes exponential time; preorder index inspection deterministically forces the only possible choice.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear tree traversal compares each node with voyage once using stack memory bounded by tree height.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should show that if node.left does not match the next voyage value, flipping is both necessary and sufficient.
complexity.notes: If matching fails at any point, the function immediately returns [-1].
